decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.32 calibration cohort integrity for release.
rationale: Visionary confirms the slice advances trustworthy AI evaluation through explicit cohort boundaries; Builder confirms executable schemas, examples, verifier rules, and 16/16 positive plus 701/701 negative checks; Guardian confirms structural claims remain bounded and missing outcomes, dependence, high-risk segments, insufficient cohorts, and drift route to governance.
recommendation: Release v0.6.32, then develop consequence-sensitive calibration in v0.6.33.
